description: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Guidelines on Presentation and Disclosure - The Segregation of the Life and General Insurance Business
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of accounting and auditing guidelines under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for insurance industry financial reporting, specifically addressing the segregation of life and general insurance businesses as mandated by the Regulation of Insurance Industry (Amendment) Act, No. 3 of 2011. This falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
